Ethan Winters (イーサン・ウィンターズ Īsan Wintāzu) (c.1984-10 February 2021) was an American mutant trained as a systems engineer. One of many mutant victims of biological weaponry, Winters was infected with a weaponized species of "Mold" during the 2017 Dulvey incident, caused by Eveline, an E-001 bioweapon created by The Connections and HCF. Following Eveline's death by his hands, Winters and his wife Mia were rescued by Chris Redfield of the Bioterrorism Security Assessment Alliance.

Fearing the Winters were now The Connections's targets, they were placed under witness protection and relocated to Eastern Europe. Since the Baker Incident, Winters received military training, and have their daughter Rosemary Winters with his wife. However, this put them in Miranda's crosshair, as Rosemary was considered to be a candidate for her daughter Eva's vessel. By February 2021, Winters was placed in the Village, where Rosemary was held by Miranda. Eventually, Winters successfully rescued Rosemary, but gave up his life to save his family from Miranda's clutches.

Little was known of Winters' early life, though by 2017 he was living and working in Los Angeles, California as a systems engineer. In May 2011, he married his Texan girlfriend, Mia, who he believed to be a high-ranking employee in a trading company but was a handler for The Connections, a crime syndicate specialised in manufacturing illegal bioweapons. By October 2014, Mia mysteriously disappeared while crossing the Gulf of Mexico during a hurricane, and was presumed dead.

On July 18, 2017, Winters received an e-mail purported to be from Mia, revealing she was at the Baker Farm in Dulvey Parish, Louisiana. Rather alerting the authorities, Winters drove out to investigate himself. However, Winters was unaware the area was being investigated by law enforcement following a series of disappearances. Winters' initial search of the "Guest House" yielded Mia's driver's license, and a tape depicting the death of Sewer Gators crew member Andre Stickland, whose remains were found soon after. When searching the basement, Winters found Mia locked in a cell and freed her. Mia was found to be amnesiac, hearing voices and actively self-harming, before becoming hostile and forcing Winters to defend himself with an axe. Locked in the house by Jack Baker, Winters received a phone call from Jack's daughter, Zoe, who told him to escape via the attic window. However, Winters was attacked again by Mia who amputated his left hand with a chainsaw.Eventually, their fight culminated in the attic, Mia incapacitated from Winters's dealt blows. His escape attempt was all for naught, as he was captured by Jack, who inflicted severe brain damage on him with a stomp to the head. He and his wife were taken back to the Main House.

Unbeknownst to Winters at the time, he and Mia, and the Bakers, had become contaminated with the Mold by a human bioweapon named Eveline; this fungus replaced cells with more resilient fungal imitations. For mere minutes he was in a state of clinical death, only beginning to wake up while being dragged into the Main House. As night fell, Winters was patched up by Zoe, who re-attached his hand and provided him with the Genome Codex, a device once belonged to Mia. Seeking a means of escape herself, Zoe conscripted Winters into helping her, using his mutations to her advantage.

Winters woke up strapped to a chair as the rest of the Baker family Jack, his wife Marguerite, and their son Lucas, and unknowingly Eveline, ate dinner. The family tried to pressure him into eating contaminated food to speed up the Mold's spread, but refused and nearly tortured by the Bakers. Winters was saved by Deputy David Anderson's arrival on the property, who was sent to investigate the disappearances. As the family left, Winters freed himself and got the deputy's attention, though he was killed by Jack upon entering the garage. Using the deputy's sidearm, Winters was able to weaken Jack who shot himself with the gun as a psychological tactic, knowing he would recover later. Winters was briefly free from pursue, and received another call from Zoe who instructed him on how to escape the property by recovering the pieces Jack had taken away to trap runaway victims.

During Winters' search of the house, he avoided attacks by the Molded, humanoid colonies of Mold created by the Bakers out of decomposing bodies of their victims. In the basement, Winters encountered Jack again, now in possession of one of the last pieces. In his attempt to reach for it, he unknowingly walked into a trap, and was cornered in the Morgue with Jack armed with a chainsaw. Yet Winters emerged victorious, having used a second chainsaw to horizontally bisect him.

Following his escape from the Main House, Winters received further instructions by Zoe at her trailer in the backyard. There, Winters was informed she and Mia were infected by the same substance that afflicted her family, but there was a chance of being treated with a serum. Having collaborated with Mia in their time of captivity, Zoe pointed Winters to the Old House, where he was to recover the arm of Dahlia, a D-Series bio-weapon prototype; Zoe meanwhile had already recovered the head of Dahlia's sister, Dolores. In his search, Winters briefly met up with Mia, no longer in delirium. However, before Winters could have answers, Mia was abducted by Lucas from behind a chainlink fence. Exploring further, Winters was attacked by Marguerite who had anticipated his search for Dahlia's arm. Their fighting collapsed part of the Old House, where a sinkhole had formed beneath the floorboards. Following her through a tunnel, Winters fought Marguerite at the greenhouse where she was killed and calcified. Returning to the Old House, Winters found Dahlia's arm, attached to a lifelike doll in a shrine created by Marguerite. In his search, Winters began to suffer visual and auditory hallucinations, both were signs of Mold infection, having seen and hear Eveline as a child.
